get.description: ADMIN or MANAGER. Inclusive Vietnam-local session_date range, default current month through today, at most 366 dates. Booking totals are current status at as_of and may include future sessions. Attendance and no-show metrics include ended sessions only. no_show is NO_SHOW / (COMPLETED + NO_SHOW), null for zero denominator. Utilization is booked seat-minutes for CONFIRMED/COMPLETED/NO_SHOW on ended OPEN sessions divided by capacity-minutes for those sessions; one booking consumes one seat regardless of PT attendance. It is reserved time, not measured workout time. Legacy ended bookings without confirmation/cancellation evidence are surfaced as unclassified. Invalid room ID returns 404; invalid date/filter returns 422.

get.description: PT SELF or ADMIN/MANAGER ALL. Inclusive Vietnam-local session_date range, default current month through today, at most 366 dates. Rating aggregates valid reviews on completed ended bookings in the selected range. Attendance uses ended confirmed COMPLETED/NO_SHOW bookings and confirmed MEMBER/PT cancellations per BR-22; FACILITY cancellations, REJECTED, EXPIRED and pending requests are excluded. Missing confirmation or UNKNOWN cancellation evidence is unclassified. Pending end-of-session CONFIRMED bookings are reported separately. A zero denominator or no reviews returns null rather than zero. PT can read only their own profile ID; managers/admins may read any existing PT. Other roles receive 403; out-of-scope or missing profile receives 404.

Half-open hourly intervals; adjacent merged, overlap rejected. Irrelevant fields rejected.
